title: Divide decimals
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review

hints.dec.divide.by-whole: Divide as if there were no point, then put the point in the answer right above where it is in the number you're dividing.
hints.dec.divide.by-decimal: Move the point in the number you divide by until it's a whole number. Move the other point the same number of places. Then divide.
hints.dec.divide: Dividing by a decimal? Move both points the same number of places first. Then divide; the point stays where it is.

misconceptionMessages.dec.divide-point: The digits are right; check the point. Divide without it, then put it back in the same place: 4.8 ÷ 6 = 0.8 (48 tenths ÷ 6 = 8 tenths).
misconceptionMessages.dec.move-one-point: Move BOTH points the same number of places. 2.4 ÷ 0.3 becomes 24 ÷ 3 = 8.

similarProblemIntro: Here's the worked solution. Now try one like it.

sections.title: Divide by a whole number
sections.objective: Divide a decimal by a whole number.
explain: 4.8 is 48 tenths. 48 tenths shared into 6 groups is 8 tenths: 0.8.
sections.key: Divide as if there were no point. The point in the answer goes right where it is in the number you're dividing.

sections.title: Divide by a decimal
sections.objective: Divide by a decimal by moving both points.
explain: Multiplying both numbers by 10 doesn't change the answer: 24 ÷ 3 is the same as 2.4 ÷ 0.3.
So move both points the same number of places, until you're dividing by a whole number.
sections.key: Make the number you divide by a whole number: move its point. Move the other point the same number of places. Then divide.

sections.title: Putting it together
sections.key: Dividing by a decimal? Move both points first. Then divide; the point stays where it is.
